description: Base DEX pair lookup through DexScreener: verified pair identity, tokens, reported liquidity, volume, trades and pair age where available. Returns source and retrieval time; missing fields are null. No pool-security or investment-risk assessment. Missing pairs return 404; upstream failure returns 502. Example values are illustrative. Use to check a pair's liquidity before trading. Costs $0.03 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

address.description: DEX pair address on Base, 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex
